item: The contention member shows as many stall records as fit its line, longest and newest
summary: contention.json fits the plan's 200,000 B line net of the write-gate section and the merge frame, in the bytes members are written in: a full ring of field-shaped records (310,767 B whole) shows 127 of 200, half longest half newest, each once, with selection.shown, of and the basis (longest+newest, fit to N B). The ring stays whole in memory and on /stall-forensics. A pin builds the widest field record through the real member and holds it to the line; six mutants fail a test.
